免费体验约半小时；现场先到先得，不保证船位。: A free introductory sail of about 30 minutes; first come, first served, with no guaranteed place.
跟随志愿船员体验海湾帆船，认识水上安全与湾区生态。活动可能受风雨和潮汐影响。: Try sailing on the Bay with volunteer skippers and learn about waterfront safety and Bay ecology. Weather and tides may affect the event.
建议 13:00 到俱乐部门前排队，登记时段为 13:00–14:30；船位先到: Arrive at the front of the clubhouse around 13:00. Sign-up runs 13:00–14:30; places are first come, first served, and tides may end sailing before 15:00.
儿童须至少 5 岁并由成人陪同；所有参加者须签免责文件，未满 18 岁由家长或监: Children must be at least 5 and accompanied by an adult. All participants must sign a waiver; a parent or guardian signs for anyone under 18. Life jackets are required and available to borrow. Wear shoes that can get wet and a windbreaker; a change of clothes is recommended.
大雨或强风可能取消活动，潮汐也可能缩短开放时段；出发前查看主办方公告，不把 15: Heavy rain or strong winds may cancel the event, and tides can shorten its hours. Check organizer updates before leaving; 15:00 is not a guaranteed last departure.
